categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction filtering logic in AvailableCoins.
categories.rationale: Guards against a null pointer dereference in AvailableCoins when checking unconfirmed outputs in the mempool without coin control. As noted in commit 6a5577f100, 'no current caller hits this: RPCs, the GUI and CreateTransaction always pass a coin control', making this a worthwhile fix for a latent crash bug rather than an active crash.
